description: An opaque cream floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted embroidered bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and finely patterned gold-toned borders is layered with a burgundy draped outer fabric. A broad brown and gold sash with decorative clasps and a small hanging chain secures the waist. The gown has flowing cream panels over a burgundy center layer. Gold-toned earrings, a pendant necklace, and pointed decorated shoes are visible.
